sn6.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || 2.
sn6.3:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarissā brāhmaṇiyā Brahmadevo nāma putto Bhagavato santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti || || 3.
sn6.3:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Brahmadevo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammad-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti || tadanuttaram brahmacariya-pariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || ||
sn6.3:2.2: Khīṇā jāti vūsitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyā ti abbhaññāsi || ||
sn6.3:2.3: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Brahmadevo arahatam ahosi || || 4.
sn6.3:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Brahmadevo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi ||
sn6.3:3.2: Sāvatthiyaṃ sapadānam piṇḍāya caramāno yena saka-mātunivesanaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || || 5.
sn6.3:3.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Brahmadevassa mātā brāhmaṇī Brahmuno āhutiṃ niccaṃ paggaṇhāti || 6.
sn6.3:3.4: Atha kho Brahmuno sahampatissa etad ahosi || ||
sn6.3:3.5: Ayaṃ kho āyasmato Brahmadevassa mātā brāhmaṇī Brahmuno āhutiṃ niccaṃ paggaṇhāti ||
sn6.3:3.6: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ tam upasaṅkamitvā saṃvejeyyan ti || || 7.
sn6.3:3.7: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya || pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya || evam evaṃ Brahmaloke antarahito āyasmato Brahmadevassa mātu nivesane pātur ahosi || || 8.
sn6.3:3.8: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati vehāsaṃ ṭhito āyasmato Brahmadevassa mātaraṃ brāhmaṇiṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn6.3:7.1: Na tassa pacchā na purattham atthi ||
